intro: Gnoll packs hold the Dust Plains, Westfall’s dry southern frontier. The plains stretch toward the coast and eastern hills, where Klaven’s Tower overlooks the wastes.

p: Across southern Westfall, the Dust Plains run from troubled farmland toward desolate wilderness. Feral gnolls have long claimed this arid ground, ambushing travelers and challenging anyone bound for the coast or nearby hills. Klaven’s Tower stands on the eastern boundary. The old mage tower is held by Klaven Mortwake, a Defias rogue, and offers no shelter from the gnolls prowling the surrounding wastes.
